notes.title: Gunmetal Arcadia now available!
notes.notes:
Hi all! [i]Gunmetal Arcadia[/i] is now available on Steam for Windows, Mac, and Linux+SteamOS!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/332270

Following the events of [i]Gunmetal Arcadia Zero[/i], Vireo and Wren have assembled a band of heroes armed to take the fight back to the Unmade Empire. Select from four playable characters and discover dozens of weapons and items in this roguelite twist on classic platforming action.

As always, you can get a 15% discount when you complete your Minor Key Games collection on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1240/

notes.title: Patch notes, week of January 9, 2017
notes.notes:
Hi all, I've just made a small update on all platforms.

[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that occurs 100% of the time when quitting the game while going through a door. (This was the most frequent crash reported by Steam's automatic error reporting by a wide margin.)
[*]Added a potential fix for a Windows-only issue reported last week in which DirectInput may fail to create a mouse device for unknown reasons.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes, week of November 22, 2016
notes.notes:
Hi all, I've been making updates and bug fixes over the last few weeks since launching first on itch.io and Humble on November 1 and subsequently on Steam November 15. Here's a complete list of everything that's changed recently:

[list]
[*]Fixed a crash when opening the controller menu while using the DualShock 4 wireless adapter
[*]Improved support for the Xbox One wireless adapter
[*]Fixed multimon support on Linux (added missing libxinerama-dev dependency)
[*]Improved multimon behavior across all platforms
[*]Fixed a crash caused by exiting a room while multiple entities (enemies or loot) were sitting on an elevator
[*]Fixed a progression blocker that could occur by dying while killing the final boss
[*]Added an option to choose between audio quality and audio perf
[*]Updated Spanish translation by Adrián Palomino
[*]Updated Patreon supporter credits
[*]Fixed a bug where stun times were very long, likely introduced by editor gremlins
[*]Fixed a bug in which the player could become attached to a boss and then crash when that boss died
[*]Added support for command line arguments on Mac and Linux for improved debugging
[*]Improved caching of achievements during offline play so these have a better chance of being granted when playing online
[/list]
